queries_run: Linde distribution channel shift OR business model transition 2026
Linde go-to-market change packaged gas digital e-commerce 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述 Linde 銷售仍以現場供氣、液態槽車（merchant）、瓶裝三種配送方式並行整合，merchant 客戶合約為三至七年的需求合約，並以區域為單位管理客戶關係；10-K 此段未描述通路或商業模式的結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: There are three basic distribution methods for industrial gases: (i) on-site or tonnage; (ii) merchant or bulk liquid; and (iii) packaged or cylinder gases. These distribution methods are often integrated, with products from all three supply modes coming from the same plant.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 兩次搜尋未找到有來源的通路顛覆、訂閱化、D2C 或平台化轉型證據；電商/數位化相關結果多為低品質網站或付費牆，不採用。
